description:
Onagh Farm Lodge is an exceptional country residence set on approximately 10.5 acres of mature, beautifully landscaped grounds, combining an impressive family home with outstanding equestrian facilities, a range of versatile outbuildings and exceptional views, all within easy reach of Enniskerry village and Dublin.

Set in a quiet and mature country setting, the property enjoys panoramic views across the surrounding countryside, with the magnificent Great Sugarloaf providing a spectacular and uninterrupted backdrop. Approached along a peaceful country road, Onagh Farm Lodge has exceptional curb appeal, with immaculate gardens, mature planting and beautifully maintained grounds creating an immediate impression of quality, privacy and tranquillity.

A charming front porchway provides a welcoming entrance to the house. Originally an old farmhouse, the property was comprehensively rebuilt, remodelled and upgraded approximately 19 years ago, with significant further improvements undertaken more recently. The result is a highly distinctive country home that successfully combines period character with contemporary design, exceptional craftsmanship and high-quality finishes.

The attention to detail throughout is exceptional. Extensive areas of glazing bring natural light deep into the accommodation, while varying ceiling heights, exposed beams, architectural angles and carefully considered design details create a wonderful sense of space.

To the front of the house are elegant formal living and dining rooms, while to the rear is the principal family living space, comprising a superb kitchen, breakfast and living area which forms the heart of the home. This impressive room features a large pitched ceiling with exposed beams and an expansive picture window framing spectacular views towards the Great Sugarloaf. Direct access leads onto a large terrace, which connects through to the formal reception areas at the front of the house, creating an excellent flow for both family living and entertaining.

The kitchen is fitted with a new bespoke Christoff kitchen in 2017 which centred around a substantial island and complemented by excellent storage and workspace. The combination of bespoke cabinetry, extensive glazing, exposed beams, generous proportions and the exceptional outlook makes this one of the home's most impressive spaces.

On the upper level is the principal bedroom suite, complete with an ensuite bathroom. A second bedroom on this level is currently utilised as an expansive walk-in wardrobe, although it could easily be returned to bedroom accommodation.

At garden level are two further bedrooms, one of which benefits from an ensuite bathroom, while the second bedroom has direct access to a large family bathroom. All rooms at this level enjoy direct access to the gardens through patio doors, creating a wonderful connection between the interior and the surrounding grounds. Also at this level is a huge and highly versatile entertaining room. This substantial space offers enormous flexibility and could be used as a home office, games room, playroom, gym, cinema or additional family living area, depending on the requirements of the new owners. The accommodation is completed by a large WC and separate utility room, providing excellent practical facilities for everyday family life.

Externally, the house is framed by carefully curated flower beds, mature trees and three immaculate lawns, each maintained by its own robotic lawnmower. The beautifully landscaped gardens also feature a selection of established fruit trees, including apple, cherry and pear, together with mature planting and colourful foliage. Exceptionally well maintained throughout, the grounds provide a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion.

The equestrian facilities are equally impressive. Within the substantial yard are six stables, comprising two mare and foal stables and four standard stables, together with a range of versatile ancillary outbuildings. These provide excellent facilities for equestrian use, storage, workshops and a variety of other potential purposes.

A particularly notable feature is the magnificent stone-cut outbuilding, measuring approximately 22 metres by 5.1 metres. This substantial building possesses tremendous character and scale and offers exciting potential for its next chapter. Subject to the necessary planning permissions, it could potentially be adapted for additional accommodation or a wide range of alternative uses.

The property also benefits from a secondary farm entrance providing convenient access to the rear lands. Together with the extensive yard, stabling, outbuildings and approximately 10.5 acres of grounds, this creates an exceptionally well-serviced and versatile holding with considerable scope for equestrian, agricultural, recreational or general land management purposes.

Onagh Farm Lodge is a property of exceptional quality, where character, architectural design and modern comfort come together within a truly special country setting. From its beautifully finished interiors and carefully considered living spaces to its mature gardens, equestrian facilities, substantial outbuildings and uninterrupted views, every aspect of the property has been thoughtfully maintained and developed.

The combination of its farmhouse origins, sophisticated architectural design, exceptional craftsmanship, recent upgrading, generous grounds and outstanding ancillary facilities makes Onagh Farm Lodge one of the most distinctive country properties to come to the Enniskerry and North Wicklow market in recent years. Location

Onagh Farm Lodge enjoys a peaceful rural setting in the townland of Onagh, just a short drive from the picturesque village of Enniskerry in north County Wicklow. Known as the “Garden of Ireland”, County Wicklow is renowned for its spectacular landscapes, rolling countryside, mountains and coastline, while Enniskerry itself offers a charming village atmosphere with a selection of cafés, restaurants, local shops, traditional pubs and everyday amenities.

The property is particularly well positioned for enjoying some of the area's best-known attractions. The renowned Powerscourt Estate, with its celebrated gardens and historic house, is just a short drive away, while Powerscourt Golf Club provides an exceptional golfing experience. The surrounding Wicklow Mountains offer a wealth of opportunities for walking, hiking, cycling and other outdoor pursuits, making the area particularly appealing to those seeking a country lifestyle without being isolated from modern amenities.

Despite its tranquil rural setting, Onagh Farm Lodge is conveniently positioned for access to Enniskerry, Bray, Greystones, South County Dublin and Dublin city centre. The N11 and M50 motorway network can be accessed via Enniskerry, providing a direct connection to Dublin and Dublin Airport, as well as the wider national road network.

The nearby coastal towns of Bray and Greystones offer an excellent selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, schools and leisure amenities, together with DART and rail services providing convenient connections to Dublin city centre and along the Dublin coastline.

Regular bus services operate between Enniskerry, Bray, Greystones and Dublin, providing further convenient transport options for residents. The combination of a peaceful rural setting with easy access to established towns, transport links and Dublin makes Onagh Farm Lodge particularly appealing to those seeking a country lifestyle without sacrificing accessibility.
